co"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ntext so you don't re-explain yourself every time."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Fully supported: **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Qwen Code**, **OpenClaw**, **Hermes Agent**,
**DeepSe"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ek Harness (dsh)**, **Cline**, **OpenCode** (1.x and 2.0), **Kilo Code**,

suppo"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"rted means the complete ambient loop (session brief, per-prompt
recall, automatic archiving), proven"},{"id":"p4s6","text":" by our test rig against the real

platform is re-verified"},{"id":"p4s8","text":" against its newest release on a fresh virtual machine,
with the results judged server-side — a vers"},{"id":"p4s9","text":"ion bump that breaks an
integration is caught by us, not by you."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The client is deliberately tiny. All the real work — storage, embeddings,
retrieval-augmented recall"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" — happens on the brethof-brain service. The client
only:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. forwards agent **hook events** to the service over HTTPS, and pastes back
the memory it returns, "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"and
2. wires the **MCP** endpoint so the memory tools are available on demand —
search (`search_brai"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"n`, `search_history`, `get_record`) and the
four doors that write: `save_project` / `save_general` ("},{"id":"p7s4","text":"a fact into the
project's history; the service's curator decides whether it becomes a
record — nothi"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ng writes records by hand), `save_note` (your session's
handover), `save_playbook` (a procedure), `s"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ave_rule` (a standing
convention), plus `add_project` with a one-line purpose."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"It has **no third-party dependencies** — pure Python standard library, so it
runs anywhere Python 3."},{"id":"p8s2","text":"*no third-party dependencies** — pure Python standard library, so it
runs anywhere Python 3.9+ does."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Supported agents"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Agent | Adapter | What you get |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **Claude Code** | built-in | Full: session memory injected, ambient recall every prompt, every tur"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"n archived, memory tools |
| **Claude Cowork** | the Claude Code plugin | Memory tools only — search"},{"id":"p11s3","text":", read and save into the memory; Cowork runs no plugin hooks, so no automatic brief or recall and Co"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"work conversations are not archived. Not part of the full-support list |
| **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)*"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"* | `adapters/dsh/` | Full: native cordis plugin on dsh's typed extension points — injection, ambien"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"t recall, archival (npm: `brethof-brain-dsh`) |
| **Qwen Code** | `adapters/qwen-code/` | Full: hook"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"s (inject + recall + archive) + MCP tools |
| **Codex** (OpenAI) | `adapters/codex/` | Full: hooks ("},{"id":"p11s8","text":"inject + recall) + archival via `notify` + MCP tools. One manual step: codex requires you to trust n"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ew hooks once — run `/hooks` and trust the brethof-brain entries |
| **OpenClaw** (gateway) | `adapt"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"ers/openclaw-gateway/` | Full: native plugin — injection, ambient recall, archival (npm: `brethof-br"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"ain-openclaw`) |

Proven on Linux and on Windows through Hermes's native installer |
| **Cline** | `adapters/cline/`"},{"id":"p11s15","text":" | Full: `beforeModel` request overlay (brief + ambient recall) + `afterRun` archival (npm: `brethof"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"-brain-cline`) |

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What leaves your machine (read this)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The client is source-available precisely so you can verify this yourself — read
`brethof_brain_clien"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"t/`; it's a few hundred lines."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- On **session start** and **each prompt**, it sends your **project name** and
(for ambient recall) "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"your **current prompt text** to the service, and injects
the memory that comes back.
- On **each ass"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"istant turn** (the `Stop` hook), it reads the *new* lines of your
agent transcript and sends them to"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" be archived as your memory — this
includes your messages, the assistant's replies, its thinking blo"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"cks, and
one-line tool-call markers (`[tool_use: Bash]`). **Tool outputs are dropped
client-side**: "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"the contents of files the assistant reads and the output of
commands it runs never leave your machin"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"e. A local offset file
(`~/.brethof-brain/state/`) ensures each line is sent once.
- Every request i"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"s authenticated with **your API key** and goes only to **your
endpoint** — your own memory container"},{"id":"p16s9","text":". Where that is depends on the shape
you chose in the account panel:
- **Local** (the default endpoi"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"nt, `http://127.0.0.1:8610`): the memory
container runs on your machine; conversations are archived "},{"id":"p16s11","text":"there and
never stored by us.
- **Hosted**: your container runs in our cloud at
`https://memory.bret"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"hof.cloud/t/<your-tenant>`, encrypted under a
passphrase only you hold — add `unlock_passphrase` to "},{"id":"p16s13","text":"your config and
the client unlocks it at session start and lets it lock itself when you
step away (`"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"lock_after_minutes`, 5–60)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Nothing else is collected. The client never sends files, environment variables,
or anything outside "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"the transcript text described above. If a hook can't reach
the service it fails silent — your sessio"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"n is never blocked. Two exceptions to
silence, both persistent conditions where staying quiet would "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"lose history: a
**rejected API key** shows a one-line notice at the next session start, and a
**TLS "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"trust failure** prints one line to stderr (seen on brand-new Windows
machines, which load root certi"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ficates lazily — open the endpoint once in a
browser and it is fixed for good)."}],"truncated":true}
